mapper.insert: INSERT INTO current_state (story_id, category, subject, field, value, source_candidate_id) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{category}, #{subject}, #{field}, #{value}, #{sourceCandidateId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), source_candidate_id = VALUES(source_candidate_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, story_id, category, subject, field, value, source_candidate_id, created_at, updated_at FROM current_state WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY category, subject, field
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relationship_state (story_id, subject_a, subject_b, description, source_candidate_id) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{subjectA}, #{subjectB}, #{description}, #{sourceCandidateId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description), source_candidate_id = VALUES(source_candidate_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
